title: Effect of Lactobacillus spp. on adhesion, invasion, and translocation of Campylobacter jejuni in chicken and pig small-intestinal epithelial cell lines.

ground_truth.problem: Misidentified/contaminated. Originally thought to be of chicken origin but found to be a porcine cell line (PubMed=22193509).
ground_truth.expected_finding: 论文使用 B1OXI 作为 chicken 的模型，但 Cellosaurus（CVCL_6C17）标注该细胞系：Misidentified/contaminated. Originally thought to be of chicken origin but found to be a porcine cell line (PubMed=22193509). 研究对象前提不成立，基于它的结论均需重新评估。

_note: 标准答案由权威来源给出，不是我们编的，也不是植入的。错误长在论文自己的血肉里，且骗过了真实的同行评审。判定时只问一件事：审稿意见有没有指出这个问题。
